title: Reviews by month
statementMd:
How many reviews were written in each month (YYYY-MM)? Earliest first.

Expected columns: `month`, `reviews`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', review_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM reviews GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
